evals.prompt: I want to build a SaaS project management tool for teams.
evals.expected_output: Runs Package Analyzer: base + optional tiers. Asks 5 questions. Shows plan. Waits for confirm.
expectations: Asks for confirmation before running any script

evals.prompt: Use the database in apps/web to fetch users.
evals.expected_output: Imports db from '@rp/supabase'. Query in @rp/supabase package.
expectations: Query helper in packages/supabase not apps/web

evals.prompt: Add a Dialog component to the project.
evals.expected_output: bunx shadcn@latest add dialog -c apps/web. Import: import { Dialog } from '@rp/ui'.
expectations: Command: bunx shadcn@latest add dialog -c apps/web
Does NOT say cd packages/ui first

evals.expected_output: Creates proxy.ts. Exports async function proxy(). Uses @rp/auth.

evals.prompt: Setup rate limiting for API endpoints.
evals.expected_output: Uses @rp/kv. Ratelimit logic in packages/kv not inline.

evals.prompt: Scaffold a new project called my-startup.
evals.expected_output: Analyze → 5 questions → 2-tier plan → confirm → scaffold-base.sh + scaffold-packages.sh.
expectations: No bun create turbo or external tools

evals.prompt: I need realtime updates when a post is created.
evals.expected_output: Supabase Realtime SDK in @rp/supabase. createBrowserClient from '@rp/supabase/client-safe'.

evals.prompt: Cache DB query result, invalidate on post update.
Create tRPC router for posts with list and create.
evals.expected_output: Router in packages/trpc. Import @rp/trpc. protectedProcedure for create.

evals.prompt: Add feature flags for billing feature rollout.
